title: Spicy salt beef with courgettes and potatoes
blurb: Pan-fried steaks with a punchy salt and pepper crust, served alongside tender potatoes and charred courgette slices.
steps: Put the new potatoes in a pan of cold salted water, bring to the boil and cook for 12 to 15 minutes until tender, then drain.
While the potatoes cook, crush the sea salt, black peppercorns and chilli flakes together using a pestle and mortar until coarsely ground.
Cut the courgettes lengthways into slices about half a centimetre thick.
Pat the steaks dry with kitchen paper, then press the spicy salt mixture firmly onto both sides of each steak.
Heat half the oil in a large frying pan over high heat and cook the steaks for 2 to 3 minutes each side for medium-rare, then remove to a plate and rest.
Add the remaining oil to the same pan and fry the courgette slices for 2 to 3 minutes each side until golden and softened.
Halve the cooked potatoes and add them to the pan with the courgettes, tossing for a minute to warm through.
Slice the steaks, divide between plates with the vegetables, and scatter over the chopped chives.
